---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement for Fuelstat
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear and concise description of the problem or limitation.

Example: "I often have to ... because there is currently no way to ..."

## Describe the solution you'd like

A clear and concise description of what you would like to happen.

How should the feature work from a user's perspective?

## Describe alternatives you've considered

A clear and concise description of alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Who would benefit from this feature?

Describe who would benefit from this feature and in which situations it would be useful.

- [ ] Private vehicle owners
- [ ] Users with multiple vehicles
- [ ] Electric vehicle owners
- [ ] Hybrid / Plug-in hybrid owners
- [ ] Other: ...

## Additional context

Add any other context, screenshots, mockups, or examples that help explain your idea.

## Willingness to contribute

Would you be interested in helping implement this feature?

- [ ] I could help with implementation.
- [ ] I could help with testing.
- [ ] I can provide feedback.
- [ ] I am suggesting the idea only.
